WeatherPage.title: Weather where we operate
WeatherPage.subhead: Current conditions for our main towns, grouped by country — tap a town for a forecast and seasonal travel notes.

WeatherTownPage.liveDataUnavailable: Live weather temporarily unavailable — please check back shortly.

WeatherSeasonalNotes.windhoek: Semi-arid, mild year-round. Short rainy season Nov-Apr (afternoon thunderstorms), driest and coolest May-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.swakopmund: Coastal desert climate -- cool and often foggy year-round, rarely hot. Morning fog is common regardless of season.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.walvis-bay: Similar coastal climate to nearby Swakopmund -- mild, dry, frequent morning fog, minimal rainfall year-round.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.luderitz: Cool, windy coastal desert town -- strong afternoon winds are common; pack a windbreaker regardless of month.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.etosha-national-park: Best game viewing in the dry season (May-Oct) when animals concentrate at waterholes; wet season (Nov-Apr) is greener but wildlife disperses.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.sesriem: Hot desert days year-round, cold nights May-Aug. Sunrise visits to the dunes avoid the worst midday heat.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.katima-mulilo: Wetter, sub-tropical climate (Zambezi region) -- rainy season Nov-Apr can affect some rural access roads.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.kinshasa: Tropical climate -- two rainy seasons (roughly Oct-Dec and Mar-May), driest Jun-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.lubumbashi: Higher-altitude, milder climate than western DRC -- distinct dry season May-Sep, rains Oct-Apr.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.kolwezi: Similar highland climate to Lubumbashi -- dry season May-Sep is the easiest time to travel.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.mbuji-mayi: Tropical savanna climate -- a clearer dry season (May-Sep) than western DRC, heavier rains Oct-Apr.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.matadi: Hot, tropical -- rainy season roughly Oct-May, a cooler dry season Jun-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.boma: Coastal tropical climate, similar pattern to nearby Matadi -- driest Jun-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.goma: Tempered by altitude (Lake Kivu region) -- generally mild, rains most pronounced Sep-May. Check current travel conditions with us before booking.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.bukavu: Similar mild, high-altitude Lake Kivu climate to Goma -- rains most pronounced Sep-May. Check current travel conditions with us before booking.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.kisangani: Equatorial -- hot and humid year-round with rain possible in any month; no sharply defined dry season.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.livingstone: Victoria Falls is at its most powerful (and mistiest) Mar-May after the rains; lowest water and clearest views Sep-Dec.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.lusaka: Rainy season Nov-Apr, cool dry season May-Aug, hot dry season Sep-Oct.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.mfuwe: South Luangwa walking safaris run in the dry season (roughly May-Oct); many camps close during the wettest months.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.siavonga: Hot Lake Kariba climate -- Sep-Nov is the hottest stretch before the rains arrive.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.chipata: Similar seasonal pattern to Mfuwe -- rains Nov-Apr, dry and best for travel May-Oct.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.victoria-falls: Falls at their most powerful Mar-May; lowest water and best photography conditions Sep-Dec.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.harare: Rainy season Nov-Mar, mild dry winter Jun-Aug, hot build-up Sep-Oct.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.bulawayo: Similar pattern to Harare -- dry season (Apr-Oct) is the easiest time to visit Matobo Hills.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.hwange-dete: Dry season (roughly Jul-Oct) brings the best game viewing as animals concentrate around waterholes.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.masvingo: Rainy season Nov-Mar, dry and mild Apr-Oct -- the easier stretch for visiting Great Zimbabwe.
